claims.evidence: Photos show the body and box label consistent with a D3300, which carries this spec by factory design, but no photo can confirm the actual sensor is present/functional or undamaged.
This is a manufacturer spec for the model; no video or burst-shot evidence was captured to confirm the unit still performs at this rate.
Spec tied to the model name on the box, but autofocus operation was not demonstrated in any photo.

risks.risk: Unknown shutter count / actual usage history
risks.proof: Photo or screen capture of the shutter count from a test shot or Nikon menu/info screen
risks.if_unproven: Price as heavily used body, near end-of-life shutter assumption

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, dust, haze)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements under light, and a photo through the lens against a bright background
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with possible optical defects

risks.risk: No proof of power-on or image capture function
risks.proof: Video or photo of camera powered on, showing live view/image on screen, plus a sample captured photo
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified function, treat as 'for parts or untested'

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap)
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories laid out together with the body and box
risks.if_unproven: Price as body+lens only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Possible mismatch between box and actual body/lens serial numbers (box could be reused)
risks.proof: Photo of serial number on body matching serial number on box
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used kit, box not counted as proof of originality

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (dents, cracked LCD, mount wear) not visible in given angles
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, bottom, and LCD screen close-up
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on and taking a sample photo
Close-up of lens front/rear elements in good light
Photo of shutter count from camera info screen
Photo of serial numbers on both body and box side by side
Photo showing any included accessories (battery, charger, card, strap) together with camera
Additional angles: top plate, bottom plate, LCD screen on
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II kit body and lens, so it can be priced, but functionality, lens condition, shutter count, and accessory completeness are all unproven and must be priced at worst case until supporting photos/video are provided.
